texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的初步探索揭示了这颗行星曾经确实是某个文明的家园。

然而，荒芜的程度表明这个文明的存在已经是非常非常久的时间以前的事情了，而且它极有可能曾经遭受到某种突然且可怖的力量袭击。残余的废墟还不足以提供关于这种外星人的生理学信息。
texts.en:
Initial exploration down on [From.Planet.GetName]'s surface reveals that this planet was indeed home to some kind of civilization.

However, the level of devastation indicates that it must've been very long ago, and it's quite likely that the civilization was struck by some kind of sudden and terrifying force. There isn't even ruins enough left to get an idea about the aliens' physiology.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
地表探测团队从行星上分离出一条无线电信号。其发信源仍暂时未知，不过已被破译的部分则已经可以开始向我们讲述这个失落已久的文明的故事了。

某种未知的威胁步步逼近这个文明；对技术的进步陷入了集体的沉迷；传言称在星系的其他地方正在建造一艘硕大无朋的宇宙战舰。这些主题在这些杂乱无章的信息里反复地出现。
texts.en:
The surface team has isolated a radio signal down on the planet. Its origin is still unknown, but translated parts have started to reveal information about the long lost civilization:

Some unidentified and approaching threat to the civilization. A collective fascination with technological advances. Rumours of a giant spaceship being built in another part of the galaxy. These themes are recurring in the scrambled messages.

texts.zh:
考古学家们设法抵达了这个神秘信号的来源——深藏于地面之下。

刚刚开始不久的遗址发掘工作，就已经表明这似乎是某种研发设施。这个地方到处都是高度微缩的多种科学设备原型。

扫描发现在其下还有一个空洞，发掘正在进行当中。
texts.en:
The archaeologists managed to home in the source of the mysterious signal. It came from deep underground.

Unearthing of the site has only just begun, but indications point to some kind of research and development facility. The place is littered with remarkably high-detail miniature prototypes of various technological devices.

Scans show a hollow space further down, and excavation is underway.

texts.zh:
我们的发掘小组有了一个有意思的发现。一组硬盘，里面记录的是作为该设施的核心焦点乃至他们整个文明核心焦点的某个持续运作的项目信息。

据描述，这是一艘能与星系间最庞大飞船相抗衡的巨大舰船。

他们在这里到底在建造一个什么样的巨大怪物？
texts.en:
Our excavation team have made an interesting discovery. A collection of miniature hard drives held information about an ongoing project that seems to have been the focal point of this installation, maybe even that of the entire civilization.

It speaks of a mighty vessel to rival the galaxy's most gargantuan flyer.

What beast of a machine did they build down here?

texts.zh:
这是一艘“巨大”的宇宙飞船！

好吧，事实证明，至少对于从前[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民来说，这艘飞船其实还蛮大的。那些我们在这里找到的微缩原型机正是飞船本身的机器，而原以为是某种设备的东西，其实是他们的首都。至于在加密信号里提到的“威胁”，实际上是一场太空技术竞赛里的对手。这个微型文明全体聚集至此则是为了尽全力夺取冠军。

不过好像我们才是这次竞赛的获奖者。
texts.en:
It's a massive spaceship!

Well, at least to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who - as it turned out - were absolutely tiny. The miniature prototypes found here were apparently their actual machines, and what was assumed to be a facility, was in fact their capitol city. The 'threat' that was mentioned in the scrambled signals turned out to be their opponents in an intergalactic tech competition. This entire mini-civilization came together trying to get the first prize!

Seems as if we are the ones to score the prize this time.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 能与小信使古怪的科技水平与容量相提并论的就是它可笑的规模了。数千个建造它的渺小生物才能塞满飞船，但如果我们想要塞进最小规格的船员还必须要对其进行大规模的改造。
texts.en: The extraordinary level of technology and capacity of The Lesser Messenger can only be rivaled by it's ridiculous scale. Of the ship's tiny creator species thousands could fit into the vessel, but to fit even a skeleton crew of our species in there is going to require a massive overhaul.

texts.zh:
一艘巨大的宇宙飞船被我们发现了！

其实只是对于原先[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民而言这艘飞船很大，因为他们这个物种十分微小。

由于畏惧某种神秘的威胁降临他们的母星，他们整个族群都聚集至此以建造一艘宇宙飞船来应对这迫在眉睫的威胁。

看上去他们还是晚了一步；毕竟他们的攻击舰还留在原地，可他们自己却消失无踪了。
texts.en:
A massive space ship have been discovered!

Or at least it was massive to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who turned out to be a minuscule species.

Fearing a mysterious threat approaching their homeworld, the entire species came together to build a space ship that could take on the impending terror.

They appear to have been too late; their assault ship is still here, but they're not.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
真是一艘宏伟的宇宙飞船啊！

一艘宏伟，却又特别小巧的宇宙飞船。这说明[From.Planet.GetName]上的原住民其实是一种微型物种。我们遇到的微缩物件其实是他们的机器，而这个损坏的设备则曾经是一座主要城市。

在听说星系另一端有人建造了一艘庞大的宇宙飞船后，这些生物决定也建造一艘飞船来比肩那个庞然大物。

真是了不得的决心与勇气，当然了，也捎带着一点可爱。
texts.en:
It's a grand space ship!

A grand, absolutely tiny space ship. As it turns out the population of [From.Planet.GetName] was a mini-species. The miniatures encountered were their actual machines, and this ruined facility was once a major city.

Having heard of a space ship of great proportions being built in another part of the galaxy, this species decided to build a ship to match the alien behemoth.

It shows great determination and courage. It's also a little bit cute.

summary.text:
# 尘中之信 / Message in the Dust

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1452；events/federations_events_1.txt:2459 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics；事件属《联邦》Federations 文件 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘察天体时，隐藏事件 ancrel.9999（on_survey_planet）以 5/405 的机会生成一个随机考古遗址（AI帝国或5年内刚发现过遗址者机会×0.2），再按各遗址的权重抽取；本遗址要求拥有《远古遗物》，权重50，出现在核爆、沙漠、干旱或草原星球上（排除部分标记的星球）。

When a body is surveyed, hidden ancrel.9999 (on_survey_planet) has a 5/405 chance to create a random dig site (×0.2 for AI empires or if a site was found in the last 5 years), then picks a site type by weight; this site needs Ancient Relics and has weight 50 on nuked, desert, arid or savannah worlds (some flagged planets excluded).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一个早已消失的文明留下的信号指向地下研发设施；他们其实是微型物种，结局随机三选一，都让玩家获得飞船“小信使”。

1. 去此万年：文明在很久以前毁灭
2. 深空凶兽：无线电信号提到逼近的“太空巨兽”
3. 原型花园：地下的原型机园区
4. 他们到底在修建什么……：微型硬盘记载一个举族投入的项目

A long-gone civilisation's signal leads to an underground R&D site; they were a miniature species, and all three random endings give the ship "Lesser Messenger".

1. Since Long Gone: a civilisation destroyed long ago
2. Beasts of Space: a radio signal mentions approaching "beasts of space"
3. Garden of Prototypes: an underground garden of prototypes
4. What are they building...: miniature drives describe a civilisation-wide project

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 胜者是…… / And the winner is...：“获胜者是……”一艘对他们而言巨大的飞船 / "And the winner is…" a ship huge to them
- 前进，征服 / Go forth and conquer：“前进吧，征服吧” / 
- 别破坏了信使 / Don't shoot the messenger：“别射信使” / 
- 飞船获得时随机受损；可开启项目“放大信使”。 / The ship comes with random damage; the project "Upscaling the Messenger" can follow.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用本遗址专属的事件池 site_lesser_messenger_random_events。 / Failed rolls draw from this site's own pool site_lesser_messenger_random_events.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：遗址定义（common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1452）的阶段顺序与条件、各阶段事件脚本、出现方式；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the site definition (common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:1452) with its stage order and conditions, every stage event script, and how the site appears; both languages read.
- 结构修正：最后一个阶段事件 fedev.9461 是隐藏的随机分派，草稿把它的几个互斥结局错排成连续阶段；现改为最后可见阶段之后的互斥分支。
- Structural fix: the last stage event fedev.9461 is a hidden random dispatcher; the draft chained its exclusive endings as consecutive stages. They are now exclusive branches after the last visible stage.
